lines.beaver: 오늘 심의에서 삭감 사유를 설명해 주십시오.
lines.beaver_en: Please explain the reason for the cut at today's review.
lines.beaver_roman: Oneul simuieseo sakgam sayureul seolmyeonghae jusipsio.
lines.learner: 네, 국고 사정이 어려워 예산을 줄였습니다.
lines.en: Yes, the national treasury is tight, so we cut the budget.
lines.roman: Ne, gukgo sajeongi eoryeowo yesaneul juryeotseumnida.

lines.beaver: 왜 하필 그 사업 예산을 줄였습니까?
lines.beaver_en: Why did you cut that project's budget of all things?
lines.beaver_roman: Wae hapil geu saeop yesaneul juryeotseumnikka?
lines.learner: 검토 결과 사업 효과가 낮아 줄였습니다.
lines.en: The review showed low project impact, so we cut it.
lines.roman: Geomto gyeolgwa saeop hyogwaga naja juryeotseumnida.

lines.learner: 조세 감면이 늘어 세금이 덜 걷혔습니다.
lines.en: Tax exemptions grew, so less tax was collected.
lines.roman: Jose gammyeoni neureo segeumi deol geochyeotseumnida.

lines.en: The affiliated agencies' budgets were cut a little too.
The vice-minister decided after many meetings.

lines.beaver_en: Weren't opinions divided within the executive branch?
lines.en: They differed at first, but the executive agreed.

lines.beaver: 관료들 권한만 지키려 한 것은 아닙니까?
lines.beaver_en: Weren't you just protecting bureaucrats' authority?
lines.beaver_roman: Gwallyodeul gwonhanman jikiryeo han geoseun animnikka?
lines.learner: 아닙니다. 이번 결정으로 늘어난 권한은 없습니다.
lines.en: No. This decision gave no one more authority.
lines.roman: Animnida. Ibeon gyeoljeongeuro neureonan gwonhaneun eopseumnida.

lines.beaver_en: Did you listen to the public's opinions too?
lines.learner: 네, 각양각색의 의견을 들은 끝에 정했습니다.
lines.en: Yes, we decided after hearing all kinds of views.
lines.roman: Ne, gagyanggaksaegui uigyeoneul deureun kkeute jeonghaetseumnida.

lines.learner: 다음 주 화요일에 다시 심의를 받겠습니다.
lines.en: We'll be reviewed again next Tuesday.
lines.roman: Daeum ju hwayoire dasi simuireul batgetseumnida.

lines.beaver_en: Understood. Thank you for all your work so far.
lines.en: Thank you. We'll work to save the treasury.
